text:
eva: Dropped a new revision of the latency/throughput dashboard in Figma: rearranged p95 card, added inline sampling quick-toggle, and a compact heatmap legend. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc
noah: Nice. Quick feedback: the inline sampling toggle feels discoverable but might be too close to the refresh button. Can we add more spacing or a subtle divider?
priya: Also, copy for the toggle should be explicit: 'Sampling: off / 1 in 10 / 1 in 2' instead of Low/Medium/High. Ops asked for exact ratios when they audit dashboards.
eva: Good point. I suggested abbreviated ratios in the UI and full explanation in hover text. Example: '1 in 10 (Light)' then hover shows the full sentence.
noah: a11y: heatmap color ramp still indistinguishable for deuteranopia simulations. Recommend dual encode: color + hatching for the lowest two bands.
priya: Can we test a hover target size for the p95 tooltip? On mobile the tooltip is hard to tap. Maybe make the p95 target 44px min hit area.
design-bot: Reminder: design token update rolled out last week — background token changed, may affect contrast checks. See https://redwood.design/tokens
eva: Thanks bot. I ran Axe locally and caught a missed contrast on the legend label when the panel is collapsed. I'll push a fix to increase weight to 600.
ops: FYI, when sampling is enabled we need a server-side flag in the query string so cached dashboards behave predictably for support. Added ticket INF-402.
priya: UX thought: show a tiny inline stat under the sampling toggle that says 'approx. visible points: ~1.2k' so users understand density impact.
noah: That helps. But watch performance: computing that on every hover could be expensive. Maybe compute on sampling change and cache for 30s.
qa-bot: Regression test idea: add an E2E that toggles sampling and asserts the chart renders and that keyboard focus reaches the sampling control.
eva: Proposed keyboard order in panel: Back button > Time range > Presets > Sampling toggle > Apply. Does that feel natural?
priya: I'd swap Presets and Time range for flow: presets first, then explicit time editors. Users generally pick a preset then adjust dates. Small hallway test?
eva: I'll prototype both and tag a short usability session. If no blockers we'll land copy and a11y tweaks by Wednesday.
ops: Also, flagging a minor status bar overlap on Firefox when the panel is narrow. I can attach a screenshot in the ticket.
noah: Thanks — can someone add the aria-label for the sampling toggle like `aria-label="Sampling ratio: 1 in 10 (Light)"` and an aria-live region that announces changes?
priya: Good call. For aria-live use polite and only announce when user toggles, not on initial render.
eva: Great feedback. I'll update the file and ping the thread when ready. :sparkles:
